desc: Long-snouted cattle animals tended to by Gaian Priests. Nassus provide wool, milk, and meat as well as their strong, if simple-minded labor in the fields.

stat.effects:
This Card is located within the Farmland Structure and generates one Supply.
You can sacrifice this Card at any time to generate 3 extra Supply for the next Month.

name: Choke Point
desc: A tight space, meant for drawing attackers in.

stat.effects:
Durability: T| Difficulty_Tr:1/N:T| Unguarded.
You may Link this to another Structure, making it Closed. A Chokepoint is always Open and cannot be Linked to any other Structures.

name: Snare
desc: Perhaps underhanded, by doubtlessly effective; the Snare is one of the eldest means of defense.

stat.effects:
The Snare may be played to any Zone, and inflicts T Notches to the first Attacker that enter it. Being used this way destroys the Card.
Only one Snare may be active in the same Zone.

name: Aether Pylon
desc: An obelisk of stone, sheathing an intricate heart of Artifice within, allowing the device to link to the Cardio-alembic and propagate its Ward. The creation of the Pylon was one of the original indic…

stat.effects:
Durability: 1| Difficulty_Tr:2/N:1| Guarded_3

Pylons cannot function without a Linked Alembic, and an Alembic can only support up to 6T Pylons at once.

This opens a Transit Route from the Hex placed in back to the Outpost, regardless of any intervening distance at all. This is also a method of travel, allowing teleporation from Gate to Outpost, and for Mines and other Structures from entirely different Shards to benefit the home Outpost.
